'''Mollie''' (Japanese: '''ミカ''' ''Mika'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG167|What I Did for Love!]]''. She is a rookie [[Pokémon Coordinator]] who made her [[Pokémon Contest]] debut at the [[Gardenia Town]] event.

Mollie seemed to have trouble finding out where to register until {{an|Brock}} told her it was at the front desk. Her {{p|Raticate}}'s [[Appeal]]s performance helped Mollie advance to the [[Contest Battle|second round]]. She used {{p|Absol}}, but the two lost to Brock and his {{TP|Brock|Marshtomp}}.

In the end, [[Top Coordinator]] [[Yuma]] decided to take Mollie under her wing and develop her Coordinator potential, as she felt that Mollie needed more advice than Brock.
